## Sign-Off  
**Created:** January 15, 2026
**Mandatory for:** All customer-facing staff before first customer contact
**Review Frequency:** Quarterly or when products change
name: Chunk 34/34

raw_entities.name: Module 1 — Customer-Facing Staff Onboarding
raw_entities.description: A mandatory training module for all customer-facing staff required before first customer contact. The module establishes foundational knowledge and compliance requirements for staff engaging directly with customers. Review is required quarterly or when products change.
context: Mandatory for: All customer-facing staff before first customer contact
Review Frequency: Quarterly or when products change

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Training Completion Before Customer Contact
raw_entities.description: All customer-facing staff must complete this training module before engaging in any first customer contact. This is a mandatory compliance requirement established as of January 15, 2026.
context: Mandatory for: All customer-facing staff before first customer contact

raw_entities.name: Quarterly Training Review and Update Obligation
raw_entities.description: Training content must be reviewed and updated on a quarterly basis or whenever banking products change. This ensures staff knowledge remains current with regulatory and product changes.
context: Review Frequency: Quarterly or when products change
